data.why: The repo bundles streamflow_results.db (precomputed 25-model training results, ~347k predictions) and Data.xlsx (raw 13,874-row discharge record); streamlit_app/app.py and all pages read these via src.config.DATABASE_PATH, which resolves relative to the repo root, so nothing needs to be copied or synthesized.

goals: Review the daily discharge time series and confirm the temporal 80/20 train/test split preserves chronological order
Compare R², RMSE, MAE and RME across the 25 ANN activation x optimizer configurations to find the best-performing model
Inspect actual-vs-predicted discharge scatter and residuals for a chosen model to judge forecast quality
Examine training/validation loss curves and early-stopping behavior to judge convergence and overfitting
Run ad hoc SQL queries against the results database to answer custom questions about model performance

review.summary: The tree states the dashboard's purpose exactly as the README does, follows its five-step order at a sensible depth, and all 10 screens I checked match their nodes. It needs small fixes before filing: f1 misdescribes the best-model banner, f2 lists an unconfirmed CSV export step, t1 has a no-op action, and the early_stopped flag and the train-vs-test metric gap are left out.
